messages.subject: International Mining & ESG Executive | Government Relations, Sustainability & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Pentz O'Connor,

I am reaching out for consideration for senior international leadership mandates across mining, energy, natural resources and sustainability.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

My strongest fit is in Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments where responsible development, institutional relationships, regulatory discipline and business execution must operate together. I work across ministries, regulators, communities, executive leadership and technical functions, turning external requirements into accountable internal action.

Your leadership across AIMS International's Sustainability and Energy & Natural Resources work makes this a focused introduction. I am open to expatriate and internationally mobile mandates across Africa, the GCC and wider global markets.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for current or future mandates aligned with ESG and Sustainability, Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership and Mining or Energy leadership.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana

messages.subject: Global Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Schofield,

I am reaching out for consideration for confidential senior leadership mandates across global mining, natural resources and energy.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and high-stakes stakeholder coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My experience is strongest where mining leadership requires more than functional ESG delivery: public-sector credibility, regulatory discipline, social licence, executive judgment and coordinated execution across operational, corporate, technical and community stakeholders.

Your leadership of ZRG's Global Mining Practice and your background across mining, oil and gas make this a focused introduction. I am open to Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments, including expatriate and rotational mandates across North America, the GCC, Africa, Asia-Pacific and other international markets.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for suitable mandates spanning ESG and Sustainability, Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership within mining and natural resources.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
